defects.summary: Render backend instance https://otravelz-backend.onrender.com is hibernating/suspended/inaccessible
defects.root_cause: Free-tier Render Web Service has timed out (>90s) and does not respond to HTTP health checks. Deployed remote clients cannot communicate with any remote backend.
defects.evidence: Probe to https://otravelz-backend.onrender.com/health timed out after 90 seconds. Recorded in reports/d1_1_production_before.json and reports/d1_1_remote_probe_evidence.json.
defects.remediation_applied_or_required: Must restart or redeploy backend service on Render or equivalent container host with Aiven DATABASE_URL and CORS_ORIGINS configured.

defects.summary: Remote frontend URLs (GitHub Pages, Render, custom domains) return 404 or DNS failures
defects.root_cause: Remote origin/gh-pages branch was last built on Sep 2, 2026 at commit 51ab34ed (pre-V4). https://o-travelz.onrender.com is 404. https://otravelz.in has no DNS records.
defects.evidence: Remote probe returned HTTP 404 for https://algoryxz.github.io/O-Travelz/ and https://o-travelz.onrender.com. Recorded in reports/d1_1_deployment_identity.json.
defects.remediation_applied_or_required: Merge feature/v4-platform-rebuild to main or run deploy-pages workflow to push compiled V4 bundle to GitHub Pages and configure custom domain DNS.

defects.root_cause: The build step executed 'npm run build' without binding VITE_API_URL, causing remote builds on GitHub Pages to fallback to same-origin relative URLs which 404.
defects.remediation_applied_or_required: RESOLVED: Added 'env: VITE_API_URL: ${{ vars.VITE_API_URL || secrets.VITE_API_URL || '' }}' to frontend build step in .github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml.

defects.summary: CORS_ORIGINS in production template must include actual frontend origin
defects.root_cause: backend/.env.example and backend/app/core/config.py provide CORS guidance, but live deployment requires explicit list matching hosting domain.
defects.remediation_applied_or_required: Ensure deployed backend environment sets CORS_ORIGINS to include https://algoryxz.github.io and custom domains.

defects.summary: frontend/vercel.json SPA rewrite intercepts relative API paths if deployed without external API URL
defects.root_cause: Wildcard rewrite /{*} -> /index.html returns HTML for unhandled API calls when no proxy is defined.
defects.remediation_applied_or_required: Documented in release notes: when deploying to Vercel, VITE_API_URL must point to the live API endpoint.

defects.summary: GOOGLE_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI in backend/.env points to unresolvable domain
defects.root_cause: Domain api.otravelz.in has no DNS records. Guest flow works offline/locally, but cloud OAuth requires DNS.
defects.evidence: DNS failure on api.otravelz.in documented in reports/d1_1_production_before.json.
defects.remediation_applied_or_required: Update GOOGLE_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI to match live backend hostname once deployed.

defects.summary: frontend/vite.config.ts lacked /images proxy in preview configuration
defects.root_cause: Preview server on port 4173 did not proxy /images requests to backend 8000, causing local production preview images to return 404.
defects.evidence: Step 4 of Golden Journey failed until preview proxy was added to vite.config.ts.
defects.remediation_applied_or_required: RESOLVED: Added '/images' proxy to both server and preview blocks in frontend/vite.config.ts.

defects.summary: Mobile menu button and mobile drawer navigation links lacked test IDs and touch target verification
defects.root_cause: Mobile drawer was only interactive via human tap without programmatic test hooks.
defects.evidence: Playwright timeout on mobile viewport click in reports/run_responsive_sanity.py.
defects.remediation_applied_or_required: RESOLVED: Added data-testid to mobile-menu-button and all drawer navigation items in StitchNavbar.tsx and StitchMobileDrawer.tsx; verified >= 40px touch targets.
